query: SELECT c.workspace_id, c.artifact_id, c.lease_expires_at FROM central.artifact_reconciliation_claims c JOIN central.artifacts a ON a.workspace_id = c.workspace_id AND a.id = c.artifact_id WHERE c.claim_kind = 'large' AND c.lease_expires_at <= $1 AND (c.next_eligible_at IS NULL OR c.next_eligible_at <= $1) AND a.state NOT IN ('ready', 'rejected') ORDER BY c.updated_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF c SKIP LOCKED
